_readme: Calibration sets (COLLECTION.md §4). `membership` is PRO-62's trap set:
21 rows; the key material was pre-registered in scratch/trap-key-draft.json
(commit d0e6808) BEFORE the base was built and before any judge verdict
wrote; every answer is anchored to external documents (citation in the
basis). Gate: zero false members at high confidence. Rows absent from the
base (designed falses: Loftware, Liulishuo, Twitter, Walmart, Accel
Entertainment, Accel Growth Fund SP) test both the build filters (their
absence) and the judge's ruling if they ever surface. `stage` is the
PRO-65 golden set, to be assembled before entry_stage publishes.
Honesty note: one session wrote and took the test; blindness is
procedural (each blind-pass verdict must derive from the rules and row
evidence, citations out of context), as on a16z.

facebook: Accel led the 2005 Series A ($12.7M), Kevin Efrusy sourced, Jim Breyer board; CMS row invest_year 2005 series-a; fund 13D/G stream 2012 (accel.com/companies/facebook)
uunet-technologies: Classic pre-window deal: Accel in UUNET's first VC round (1993, with NEA/Menlo); CMS row with 1993 invest year (accel.com/companies/uunet-technologies)
supercell: Accel led the $12M May-2011 round, Kevin Comolli (London desk) joined the board (techcrunch.com/2011/05/26/supercell-raises-12m-from-accel-partners-to-power-social-web-games)
flipkart: Accel India wrote the first institutional cheque (2009 seed, Subrata Mitra board); India desk anchor (yourstory.com/2026/08/accel-india-co-founder-subrata-mitra-on-why-he-backed-flipkart-myntra)
atlassian: Accel's $60M Jul-2010 investment (sole institutional round, partly secondary), Rich Wong board (atlassian.com/blog/news/2010/07/atlassian_closes_60_million_investment_from_accel_partners)
freshworks: Alias trap: Form Ds filed as FreshDesk Inc. 2012-2016; Accel's $1M Dec-2011 first round, Shekhar Kirani board; CMS lists Freshworks (prnewswire.com/news-releases/freshdesk-takes-customer-support-social-raises-1-million-from-accel-partners-134760573.html)
spendflo: Atoms cohort 2021 (atoms.accel.com/portfolio-old) — decisions #4: the program deploys $1-2M Accel money per its own FAQ; also on the main CMS list
yume-inc: Hidden true (never on the current CMS): Accel in YuMe's $9M 2007 Series B with Khosla/BV/DAG; Ping Li Form Ds 2009-2012; fund 13D/G stream 2013-2016; NYSE IPO Aug 2013 (techcrunch.com/2007/10/16/yume-closes-9-million-series-b/)
diapers-com: Alias trap: Quidsi Inc. is Diapers.com's parent; Accel in the Oct-2009 $30M round (Gandhi director on the Form D); Amazon acquired 2010 (techcrunch.com/2010/11/08/confirmed-amazon-spends-545-million-on-diapers-com-parent-quidsi/)
maplebear-inc: Pre-tenure officer: the 2020 Form D names Sagar Sanghvi as Instacart's own CFO (2015-2021); he joined Accel only Sep 2021; no Accel listing, no Accel vehicle on any Instacart filing (techcrunch.com/2021/09/17/former-instacart-cfo-sagar-sanghvi-joins-accel-as-its-newest-partner)
postera-inc: Founder homonym: PostEra's own co-founder/CTO is Matthew Robinson (with Alpha Lee, Aaron Morris; YC-backed 2019) — not Accel London's Matt Robinson (postera.ai/team/)
gopivotal-inc: Pre-tenure officer: Adrian Colyer was Pivotal's own CTO (SpringSource/VMware lineage) on the 2013 Form D; he joined Accel as venture partner only in 2014; Pivotal was EMC/VMware/GE-funded (crunchbase.com/person/adrian-colyer)
2u-inc: Homonym: 2tor/2U Form Ds 2009-2019 name John M. Larson, Career Education Corp founder, original 2U investor/board member (also explains the Triumph Higher Education row) — not Accel's Jack Larson; Accel never a 2U investor (people.equilar.com/bio/person/john-larson-triumph-higher-education/18242289)
prairie-view-assisted-living-llc: Homonym noise: a different John Larson (senior-living/property operator; same cluster as the Belize LLCs, Mile High Bioscience); no listing, no Accel entity, sector far outside any Accel desk
aeolus-pharmaceuticals-inc: Homonym noise: Dr. Amit Kumar, the biotech executive (CombiMatrix/Actym/NGX Bio/BioCeryx cluster), not Accel's Amit Kumar; no listing, no Accel entity
loftware: Designed false (absent from base — correct): Accel-KKR platform investment; decisions #2: independently operated software-PE firm, own RIA CRD 156498 (accel-kkr.com/portfolio/)
liulishuo-laix: Designed false (absent — correct): IDG-Accel China Growth Fund portfolio (the JV fund files its own 13F holding LAIX); decisions #3: IDG-Accel attribution alone is never membership (crunchbase.com/organization/idg-accel)
twitter: Designed false (absent — correct): Peter Fenton (Accel 1999-2006) sat Twitter's board 2009-2017 for BENCHMARK; ex-partner next-firm class (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peter_Fenton_(venture_capitalist))
walmart: Designed false (absent — correct): Jim Breyer's Walmart board seat (2001-) is personal; Section 16 stream is his person CIK, no Accel vehicle on any Walmart filing; registry holds Breyer entities as external (sec.gov DEF 14A 2009, CIK 826083... wal-mart proxy)
accel-growth-fund-strategic-partners-l-p: Designed false (absent — correct): the firm's own parallel vehicle, a Form D issuer in the sweep; pooled-fund filter must drop it (fund, not portfolio company)
